explanation.meaning: 这个团队在设计领域有一些局部突出的亮点，但整体仍难以稳定地交付成果。
similar_expressions: The team has isolated strengths in design, but it still struggles to deliver consistently. — 用 isolated strengths 替代 pockets of greatness，强调优势是零散孤立的，而非成块分布的。
The team shows occasional brilliance in design, but it still struggles to deliver consistently. — 用 occasional brilliance 替代 pockets of greatness，强调优秀表现是偶发的，而非固定存在的局部区域。

examples.english: The new product team has pockets of greatness in user research, but it still struggles to ship on time.
examples.chinese: 这个新产品团队在用户研究方面有一些局部亮点，但仍难以按时交付。

evidence: We need to take an honest look at how the team is performing.
The team has pockets of greatness in design, but it still struggles to deliver consistently.
Our next step is to make those strengths part of our everyday process.

output.teacher_note: 这句话先肯定团队设计上的局部亮点，再用转折指出其产出不稳定的问题，为后续改进做铺垫。记忆时可把 pockets of greatness 与“局部亮点”绑定，遇到评价团队表现的场景直接套用。

reusable_patterns.template: [team] has pockets of greatness in [area], but it still struggles to deliver consistently.

slots.team: 替换为被评价的具体团队或群体
slots.area: 替换为具体的优势领域
